templates.source: Interlogix TruVision IP cameras run the Hikvision platform (Interlogix TruVision line is Hikvision OEM). The official Interlogix TruVision configuration manuals confirm the Hikvision-platform streaming stack and RTSP settings: 'TruVision IP Camera Configuration Manual Firmware 4.X.X' (interlogix.com/docs/1072627A_TruVision_IP_Camera_Configuration_Manual.pdf), 'TruVision IP Camera Configuration Manual Firmware 5.0X' (TVD-1106 manual, surveillance-video.com/.../TVD-1106-Manual.pdf), 'TruVision M Series IP Camera Configuration Manual' and 'TruVision ANPR IP Camera Configuration Manual' — all document the identical Hikvision RTSP configuration UI (Configuration > Security > RTSP Authentication, digest/basic auth, RTSP Port default 554). The standard Hikvision resource path /Streaming/Channels/<ch><stream> — 101 = channel 1 main stream — is therefore the main-stream RTSP path. Published on OEM-lineage basis (the official Interlogix config manuals confirm the Hikvision platform + port 554 but do not print a literal example rtsp:// URL string); corroborated by the dominant StrixCamDB leads /Streaming/Channels/1 and /Streaming/Channels/2.

Hikvision RTSP path /Streaming/Channels/102 = channel 1 sub-stream (103 = third stream where supported). Same OEM-lineage basis as main stream — see main-stream source; the TruVision configuration manuals expose main/sub/third stream settings on the Hikvision platform. Port 554.

unverified_leads.note: Short Hikvision-form channel index (channel 1). Valid on the Hikvision platform as an alias but the canonical current form is /Streaming/Channels/101; kept here as the literal lead-form. Confirms Hikvision lineage.
Short Hikvision-form (channel 2 / older sub-stream alias). Canonical form is /Streaming/Channels/102 for channel-1 sub. Hikvision-platform lead.

Legacy non-Hikvision GE Security / UltraView-era firmware path. Widely repeated by crowdsourced aggregators (ispyconnect etc.) but NOT confirmed in any official Interlogix TruVision document; excluded from verified templates. May apply to older pre-Hikvision Interlogix/GE units.

Generic Hisilicon-style ch<N>_<N>.h264 lead (also appears as /ch0_0.h264 with leading slash) — not the Hikvision /Streaming/Channels form used by TruVision; not in any official Interlogix doc. Cross-brand / legacy contamination, excluded.
Generic /video.h264 lead (also without leading slash) — not confirmed in any official Interlogix/TruVision document; cross-brand contamination, excluded.

notes: Interlogix (GE Security lineage; UTC / Carrier Fire & Security) — the TruVision IP camera and NVR line is Hikvision OEM and runs the Hikvision platform. The official Interlogix TruVision configuration manuals (FW 4.X.X, FW 5.0X/TVD-1106, M Series, ANPR, 81 Series, 360°) confirm the Hikvision RTSP stack: RTSP default port 554, RTSP Authentication (digest/basic, MD5/SHA256) at Configuration > Security > RTSP Authentication, and main/sub/third stream configuration — i.e. the standard Hikvision resource path /Streaming/Channels/<ch><stream> (101 main, 102 sub, 103 third). No official Interlogix document prints a literal rtsp:// example URL, so the concrete paths are published on confirmed Hikvision-OEM/platform basis (same convention as other Hikvision-OEM brands like Advidia A-series and American Dynamics), and match the dominant StrixCamDB leads (/Streaming/Channels/1, /Streaming/Channels/2). HTTP MJPEG preview is available at http://IP/Streaming/channels/101/httpPreview (Hikvision form) where enabled. The legacy leads /h264_stream, /ch0_0.h264, /video.h264 likely belong to older pre-Hikvision GE Security / UltraView / TVIP firmware — none could be confirmed against an official Interlogix document and are recorded under unverified_leads rather than published. ONVIF is supported on TruVision IP cameras for auto-discovery (RTSP URI via GetStreamUri) as an alternative to the fixed path.
